stats.method: each control runs the REAL producer end to end against a mutated registry (synapse.mcp.tools.get_tools patched), never a re-implementation

controls.claim: the reader reproduces T.0's 17,310 from T.0's own registry
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if its serialisation or tokenizer differed from T.0's; mutation adds 3 words to one historical description
controls.detail: a calibration gate that stays green under a mutated input is not a gate

controls.claim: the four decomposed fragments rebuild each wire object byte-for-byte
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if a tool carried a fifth key whose mass vanished into the structural residual; mutation adds outputSchema to one tool

controls.claim: the description component total is the sum of real per-tool description fragments
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if it double-counted or dropped tools; mutation appends one tool with a description of independently-computed token cost
controls.detail: exact-delta control: an approximate match would indicate mis-attribution

controls.claim: repeat_count and ceiling_saving reflect real repetition
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if it counted per-tool rather than per-instance; mutation copies the property 'node' into one additional tool
controls.detail: predicted ceiling delta = exactly one fragment's tokens

controls.claim: a surface with no repeated fragments reports no duplication saving
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if it reported savings on unique input - the classic check-that-cannot-fail; mutation makes every property name and description unique
controls.detail: paired negative control - the thing probe_phase3_layout was missing

controls.claim: '2,000 is not reachable' is computed against the committed ceiling file
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if the verdict were hardcoded; mutation raises the ceiling file to 99,999 and the verdict must flip to reachable

controls.claim: the catalog floor scales with tool COUNT, which is why the ceiling is a count statement rather than a size statement
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if the floor were insensitive to tool count; mutation halves the registry to 60 tools
controls.detail: halving the count moves the floor from over-ceiling to under-ceiling

controls.claim: each floor is strictly cheaper than the one above it
controls.fails_when: it would be wrong if a 'reduction' step increased cost, which would mean the payload construction is not doing what its label says
controls.detail: structural self-check; no external mutation needed
